newsitem.title: USA: Grossman's says financing may be at risk.
newsitem.headline: Grossman's says financing may be at risk.

text.p: Grossman's Inc said Tuesday it was advised late Monday by GDI Co Inc that GDI is not prepared to proceed with debtor-in-possession financing for Grossman's until GDI resolves certain issues with Congress Financial Corp, Grossman's revolving credit lender.
Grossman's announced its Chapter 11 Bankruptcy Code filing Monday and said GDI had committed to provide up to $50 million of debtor-in-possession financing.
Grossman's said today there could be no assurance that GDI's negotiations with Congress Financial will be successful.
Three executive officers of JELD-WEN Inc, an affiliate of GDI and a major supplier of Grossman's, are among the seven members of the Grossman's board, Grossman's said.
